data.gender_notes: Manzuma is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'manzuma' which means 'gathered' or 'united'. This name signifies coming together or unity, both in the spiritual and communal sense. The name Manzuma carries the meaning “Gathered, United” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Manzuma usually hope their child will grow to embody gathered, united and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manzuma total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
